about_the_game:
"

Starfinder Flip-Mat - Casino


Place your bets on high adventure with this Starfinder Flip-Mat featuring two different far-future casino! Rub shoulders with the high and mighty at a high-stakes upper class gambling palace, or dip down to the seedy side of town with a dark and dingy gambling den. Starfinder Flip-Mats present ready-to-use science-fantasy set pieces for the busy Game Master. With Starfinder Flip-Mat: Casino, you'll be ready the next time your players decide to gamble with their lives!

NOTE: This product has been made specifically for the starfinder ruleset, but can be used for 5E, Pathfinder, or any ruleset supported by Fantasy Grounds
This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:
  • All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
  • All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them
"
